description_en: Sets a remark for a single Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 为单个DDoS原生防护实例设置备注
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp modify-remark --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRemark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance for which you want to set a remark.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要设置备注的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The remark for the Anti-DDoS Origin instance
parameters.help_zh: 为DDoS原生防护实例设置备注
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
